name: Delos spared
note: Datis anchored off and would not land armed men on the sacred island. The gesture is the record; the course between is not.

name: Karystos reduced
note: The Euboean towns were taken in turn on the way north.

name: Eretria besieged
note: Six days of assault, then the gates opened from inside. The city was burned and its people enslaved.

name: The landing at Marathon
note: HIPPIAS CHOSE THE GROUND. He had been tyrant of Athens and knew the plain was the best cavalry country in Attica.

name: The Athenians march out
note: Out to meet a landing rather than waiting behind walls. The road over Pentelikon is not recorded and is not drawn.

name: The Plataeans come
note: A thousand men, the whole force of a small city, and the only allies to arrive.

name: The Persians re-embark
note: Seven ships were taken at the water's edge. The rest got away.

name: The fleet rounds Sounion
note: Making for an undefended Athens by sea. The course round the cape is the obvious one and IS NOT RECORDED — the zigzag says from here to here.

name: The army marches back
note: THE RACE THAT DECIDED IT. The same men who had just fought, arriving before the fleet could land.

name: The fleet turns away
note: They lay off Phaleron, saw the army drawn up, and sailed for Asia.
